content:
踏上《Enchanted Expeditions》的驚險冒險，這是一款沉浸式的 Minecraft 整合包，完美結合了原始洞穴的探索樂趣、趣味小工具、可愛的絨毛玩偶以及各式萌寵。內建 Create、Electrodynamic 與 AE2 等熱門模組，為您帶來獨特且迷人的遊戲體驗。

![Updated to Alex's Cave 2.0](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f4814b8a80b8389d18706bbfd3e801da8d76d90f_0.webp)
![Eruption Update now live](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/354df0b7e9517e3d77d94248707890435549e0ee.png)
已更新至 Alex Caves 2.0+

**亦包含 Ice and Fire、Botania 與 ~~Destroy~~！**

## 專為 MC 1.20 打造的萬用整合包，內含：
- **探索**
    - [Alex's Cave](https://modrinth.com/mod/alexs-caves) 與 [Alex's Mobs](https://modrinth.com/mod/alexs-mobs)
    - [Ice and Fire](https://modrinth.com/mod/ice-and-fire-dragons)
    - [Ad Astra](https://modrinth.com/mod/ad-astra)、[BOP](https://modrinth.com/mod/biomes-o-plenty) 與 [Mystic's Biomes](https://modrinth.com/mod/mystics-biomes)
    - [Ribbits](https://modrinth.com/mod/ribbits)、[Yung's Better Structures](https://modrinth.com/user/YUNGNICKYOUNG) 以及大量結構！
- **科技**
    - [IE](https://modrinth.com/mod/immersiveengineering)、[Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) 與擴充模組
    - [AE2](https://modrinth.com/mod/ae2)、[Electrodynamic](https://modrinth.com/mod/electrodynamics) 與 [Nuclear Science](https://modrinth.com/mod/nuclear-science)
- **趣味與道具**
    - [I Wanna Skate](https://modrinth.com/mod/i-wanna-skate)、[Artifacts](https://modrinth.com/mod/artifacts) 與 [Simple Hats](https://modrinth.com/mod/simple-hats)
    - [Camera](https://modrinth.com/mod/camera-mod)、[WebDisplays](https://modrinth.com/mod/webdisplays)、[Immersive Melodies](https://modrinth.com/mod/immersive-melodies) 與 [Tempad](https://modrinth.com/mod/tempad)
- **裝飾**
    - [Furnish](https://modrinth.com/mod/furnish-furniture)、[AMW plushies](https://modrinth.com/mod/a-man-with-plushies)、[Supplementaries](https://modrinth.com/mod/supplementaries) 與 [Handcrafted](https://modrinth.com/mod/handcrafted)

另外加入了超過 10 個效能優化模組，僅需 4GB 記憶體即可流暢遊玩；在 v2.0 版本中則建議準備約 5GB 記憶體。
